about: Karamja's jungle monsters (Karamja step K4.1): the jungle spiders, monkeys, snakes, jogres, tribesmen, scorpions (Cairn Isle's among them) and hobgoblins of the jungle between Brimhaven, Musa Point and the Kharazi Jungle's edge, where the mejrs NPC list puts them and no other spawn file does. Left out: the Kharazi Jungle (its own step), Tai Bwo Wannai's and Shilo Village's people (steps K4.2, K4.3), the harpie bug swarms (Slayer, their bug lantern isn't built), the fly traps.
